name: kb_891_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: IDRange provides a min/max of an allowed range of IDs.

max.description: max is the end of the range, inclusive.

min.description: min is the start of the range, inclusive.

schema.description: RunAsGroupStrategyOptions defines the strategy type and any options used to create the strategy.

ranges.description: ranges are the allowed ranges of gids that may be used. If you would like to force a single gid then supply a single range with the same start and end. Required for MustRunAs.

rule.description: rule is the strategy that will dictate the allowable RunAsGroup values that may be set.

description:
The group‑ID strategy for this deployment is set to **MustRunAs**, meaning every pod must be assigned a GID that falls within the permitted intervals. The allowed ranges are from **1,000 through 2,000** (inclusive) and a single fixed GID of **3,000** for cases where a specific group ID is required.

In practice, this configuration forces the runtime to select a group identifier from either of those two windows; if a precise GID is needed, the second range effectively locks the value to 3,000. No other GIDs will be accepted under the current policy.
